arms.R0_L0: Candidate representation plus candidate SGD log-loss/class_weight-balanced learner.
arms.R0_L1: Candidate representation plus u4 LinearSVC/balanced-ratio-9.8 learner.
arms.R1_L0: u4 representation plus candidate SGD log-loss/class_weight-balanced learner.
arms.R1_L1: u4 representation plus u4 LinearSVC/balanced-ratio-9.8 learner.

classification_rule.interaction_dominant: Neither main effect is stable and absolute interaction >= 0.01 with the same sign in at least four reviews.
classification_rule.stable_component: Absolute mean component effect at recall@10% >= 0.01, same sign in at least four of five reviews, and magnitude at least half the absolute V3 full-arm gap.

estimands.interaction: (R1_L1-R0_L1)-(R1_L0-R0_L0), reported per review and as an unweighted mean.
estimands.learner_balancer_main_effect: Average of (R0_L1-R0_L0) and (R1_L1-R1_L0) on review-level recall@10% and WSS@95.
estimands.representation_main_effect: Average of (R1_L0-R0_L0) and (R1_L1-R0_L1) on review-level recall@10% and WSS@95.
estimands.tail_diagnostics: Recall@5%, recall@20%, fraction screened to 95% recall and WSS@95 for every arm and review.

forbidden_changes: pooled-row substitution for the review-level estimand
nonpromotion_rule: No arm may replace the candidate or support a superiority claim on SWIFT. Any selected component combination must be frozen without outcome access and tested on a content-disjoint review family with the same active u4 comparator and unchanged safety gates.
population: Exact V3 canonical rows, seeds, batches, review retention, metrics and review-level aggregation.
scope: Post-outcome public-development mechanism diagnosis; not a superiority retest, confirmation, or controller promotion study.
